scientific_integrity.classical_input: Gale evenness criterion and the published exact transversal-number theorem are credited as prior results.
scientific_integrity.contribution: Exact classification and count of *all* minimum transversals, and parity-dependent asymptotic growth.
scientific_integrity.provenance: Written proof with a standalone direct Gale enumerator; no external expert or formal proof certificate claimed.

scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to even-dimensional cyclic polytopes with n>=2k+1, labeled vertices and facet transversals.
No independent audit or historical-priority certification was performed; an unindexed equivalent combinatorial enumeration remains possible.
Finite Gale-evenness tests check small instances but do not certify the all-dimensional theorem.
title: Parity-sensitive enumeration of minimum facet transversals of even-dimensional cyclic polytopes
